sentences.en: Affirming the consequent is an example of a formal logical fallacy.
sentences.zh: 肯定后件是一种形式逻辑谬误的例子。

sentences.en: Her hard work resulted in a promotion, which was the consequent.
sentences.zh: 她的辛勤工作得到了晋升，这是结果。

sentences.en: Consequent to the rainstorm, we had to cancel the outdoor picnic.
sentences.zh: 由于暴风雨，我们不得不取消户外野餐。

senses.zh: 随之发生的；作为结果的
